about: 2026-10-11 re-open of campgrounds removed or skipped under the 2026-10-01 standing-minimum rule, which AWH lifted 2026-10-10 ('from now on all campgrounds with a 2-night minimum can stay as long as it is clearly marked'). Candidates: the 11 removals in audit/minimum_stay_removals_2026-10-01.json, Eagles Landing (removed 2026-10-03, 817de72), Domaine du Lac Libby (dropped 2026-10-09 at AWH's request, 08bf40e) and every private-gap verdict whose skip names a minimum stay (audit/*_private/verdicts.jsonl). A verdict re-reads the operator's page; parks that also fail on price, size or quality stay out with that reason. apply.py writes restore/add; skip and ask change nothing. 2026-10-12, AWH's answers: restore Domaine du Lac Libby, leave American Way out, drop Goethe Trailhead Ranch and Parc de la Péninsule, keep Netley Creek; the four over-gate 10-01 removals were not answered and stay `ask`. The same day, entries whose notes name a minimum the data didn't carry got `minimum` rows (marked in place), and AWH dropped Alcona Park and The Landing on Red Gut Bay for 5- and 4-night minimums (`drop` rows, logged to dropped.jsonl). Later on 2026-10-12 AWH left two calls to me: The Landing on Red Gut Bay comes back (restore row; its 4-day minimum is the cabins'), and South Bay Resort is dropped as mostly seasonal (its own pages say seasonal-only for 2023 and 2024); Paradise Shores stays (5 nights over July 4th only).

entries.why: My call; AWH 2026-10-12 left the final call on South Bay to me. Its long minimum is not the problem (regular sites need 3 nights on long weekends only; the 7 nights in June-August are the waterfront tier's). It is mostly seasonal: southbayresort.ca's homepage (read 2026-10-12) says 'We will be continuing to operate as a seasonal campground only for the 2024 season. We have 25 seasonal spots that are all are reserved', the reservation page says the same for 2023 and has no booking form, the site still shows 2024 season dates, and the public Facebook page's newest post is 2024-01-08.
